rules.note: The Grand Tour is one Simkl entry. Its season 7 is the 2026 revival, which TMDB carries as a separate show starting at season 1.
The revival has no TVDB id and an IMDb id too new for Simkl to index, so writes to this entry carry the 2016 run's ids.

Simkl keeps both LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy runs as one entry. Its season 2 is Pieces of the Past, which TMDB carries as a separate show with no external ids at all, so a write addressed by that show reaches nothing.
